package.name: cobot_health
package.description: System health: the HeartbeatPublisher helper every node embeds (one low-frequency Heartbeat on /health/heartbeat with node-specific metrics) and the health_monitor node that aggregates them into a latched /health/summary with staleness detection. Depends on rclpy + cobot_interfaces only, so every package (including cobot_tasks) may use it.
